senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (तुणति)
1 To curve, to bend or make crooked.
2 To act fraudulently.

r. 1st cl. (तूणयते)
To fill, to fill up.
(तूणयति)
To shrink, to contract, to close as the eye-lids or wink.

mfn. (-णः-णा or -णी)
A quiver, &c.
f. (-णी)
Indigo.
E.
तूण to be filled (with arrows, &c.) अच् and टाप् affixes, or घञ् and ङीष्.

m. (-णिः)
A timber tree: see तुन्न.
E.
तूण to shrink or warp, affix कि, and the radical vowel made short.

m. (-ण्डः)
The mouth, the face.
E.
तुडि to tear, (food, &c.) affix अण्, and कन् being added तुण्डक.

f. (-री)
A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica monadelpha.)
E.
तुण्डक the mouth, ऋ to go, अण् and ङीष् affs.

mf. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी)
1 The mouth, the face.
2 A beak.
3 The navel; (also तुन्दि.)
E.
तुडि to break or destroy, Uṇādi affix इन्.

f. (-का)
1 The navel.
2 A plant, commonly Telakuca.
E.
कन् added to तुण्डी.

f. (-री)
1 The cotton plant.
2 A sort of gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.)
2 A large boil or swelling on the palate.
E.
तुण्डिका the mouth or beak, ऋ to go, affixes अण् and ङीष्; also with कन् added तुण्डिकेरिका. f. (-का) and with इन् fem. affix तुण्ठिकेरि. f. (-रिः) also तुण्डकेरी and तुण्डिकेशी.

f. (-शी)
A sort of gourd, commonly Telakuca: see the preceding.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Having a prominent or elevated navel.
E.
तुण्डि the navel, भ affix; also तुन्दिभ, &c.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Having a prominent or elevated navel.
2 Speaking harshly or severely.
E.
तुण्डि the navel, and ल affix; also तुन्दिल, &c.

n. (-कं)
A measure of verse, species of the अतिशर्करी metre.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Having a quiver, quivered.
m. (-णी)
The Tūn tree.
E.
तूण, and इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
A quiver.
E.
तूण to be filled (with arrows), ईरण् aff.
